title: Collective Autonomous Vehicle Routing Needs Social Awareness for Coexistence with Human Drivers
title_zh: 集体自动驾驶车辆的路径规划需要具备社会意识，以实现与人类驾驶员的共存

paragraphs.en: Collective Autonomous Vehicle (AV) route choices in real-world traffic networks can create externalities for Human-Driven Vehicles (HDVs), as routes that benefit AVs may increase travel times for other road users. To address this, we introduce a social component, the marginal cost, to the selfish travel time AV reward. Marginal cost captures an AV’s impact on other road users by comparing their travel times with those in a counterfactual simulation in which the AV is removed.
paragraphs.zh: 在真实世界的交通网络中，集体自动驾驶车辆（AV）的路线选择可能会对人类驾驶车辆（HDV）产生外部影响，因为有利于 AV 的路线可能会增加其他道路使用者的出行时间。 为了解决这个问题，我们在自利的出行时间 AV 奖励中引入了一个社会性要素——边际成本。 边际成本通过将其他道路使用者的出行时间与一个反事实模拟中的时间进行比较来反映 AV 对他们造成的影响，在该模拟中，AV 被移除。

sents.en: Collective Autonomous Vehicle (AV) route choices in real-world traffic networks can create externalities for Human-Driven Vehicles (HDVs), as routes that benefit AVs may increase travel times for other road users.

sents.en: Marginal cost captures an AV’s impact on other road users by comparing their travel times with those in a counterfactual simulation in which the AV is removed.
sents.zh: 边际成本通过将其他道路使用者的出行时间与一个反事实模拟中的时间进行比较来反映 AV 对他们造成的影响，在该模拟中，AV 被移除。

paragraphs.en: We study AV route choice in mixed-autonomy traffic settings using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), where AVs learn routing policies through repeated interactions with the traffic environment. Experiments on the real-world networks of Ingolstadt and Provins show that incorporating marginal cost into the AV reward not only limits the increase in HDV travel times and shortens AV travel times relative to selfish AV routing, but also improves overall system performance . In Ingolstadt, selfish routing of 40% AVs increases the travel times of other vehicles by 1.7%, and this drops to 1.1% when the social reward is included. Interestingly, not only does overall system performance improve, but the AVs are also better off when acting socially. This effect is consistent across tested cities, penetration rates, and replications, yet when the weight of the social component in the reward increases, the system fails to reach the desired performance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用多智能体强化学习（MARL）方法，研究混合自主性交通环境中的自动驾驶车辆（AV）路线选择问题，其中 AV 通过与交通环境的反复互动来学习路线策略。 在英戈尔施塔特和普罗文斯真实路网上的实验表明，将边际成本纳入 AV 的奖励机制中，不仅限制了重型车辆（HDV）行驶时间的增长，并相对于自利型 AV 路线缩短了 AV 的行驶时间，还提升了整体系统性能。 在英戈尔施塔特，40% 的 AV 采用自利型路线时，会使其他车辆的行驶时间增加 1.7%；而当引入社会性奖励后，这一增幅降至 1.1%。 有趣的是，不仅整体系统性能得到提升，AV 在采取社会性行为时自身也能获得更好的结果。 这种效应在所有测试城市、渗透率和重复实验中均保持一致，但当奖励中社会性成分的权重增加时，系统却未能达到预期的性能水平。

paragraphs.en: For a more scalable approach to social AV routing in mixed-autonomy traffic, we compute the marginal cost only for the AVs whose route choices most affect the traffic system. This reduces the number of counterfactual simulations and achieves similar performance at a significantly lower computational cost.

paragraphs.en: Our results suggest that AV routing should go beyond selfish rewards and, for the benefit of all traffic participants, include a social component in its objective.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果表明，AV 路由不应局限于自私的奖励机制，而应从所有交通参与者的利益出发，在其目标函数中加入社会性要素。

paragraphs.en: Keywords: Autonomous vehicles, urban route choice, multi-agent reinforcement learning, social awareness, reward shaping.
paragraphs.zh: 关键词：自动驾驶汽车、城市路线选择、多智能体强化学习、社会感知、奖励塑造。

paragraphs.en: Every day, human drivers commute through urban traffic networks, choosing among several possible routes the ones with the minimal expected perceived travel time [ 38 , 4 ] . The growing presence of Autonomous Vehicles (AVs) in cities may introduce new dynamics, as AVs may deviate from the shortest routes provided by real-time navigation systems and can use a variety of algorithms to learn routing strategies, potentially achieving shorter travel times than Human-Driven Vehicles (HDVs) or disadvantaging them by consistently increasing their travel times [ 16 , 28 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 每天，人类驾驶员都会在城市交通网络中通勤，从多条可能的路线中选择预期感知旅行时间最短的路线 [ 38 , 4 ] 。 自动驾驶汽车（AVs）在城市中的日益普及可能会带来新的动态，因为自动驾驶汽车可能会偏离实时导航系统提供的最短路线，并可以使用多种算法来学习路由策略，从而可能比人类驾驶车辆（HDVs）实现更短的旅行时间，或者通过持续增加后者的旅行时间来使其处于不利地位 [ 16 , 28 ] 。

sents.en: Every day, human drivers commute through urban traffic networks, choosing among several possible routes the ones with the minimal expected perceived travel time [ 38 , 4 ] .
sents.zh: 每天，人类驾驶员都会在城市交通网络中通勤，从多条可能的路线中选择预期感知旅行时间最短的路线 [ 38 , 4 ] 。

sents.en: The growing presence of Autonomous Vehicles (AVs) in cities may introduce new dynamics, as AVs may deviate from the shortest routes provided by real-time navigation systems and can use a variety of algorithms to learn routing strategies, potentially achieving shorter travel times than Human-Driven Vehicles (HDVs) or disadvantaging them by consistently increasing their travel times [ 16 , 28 ] .
sents.zh: 自动驾驶汽车（AVs）在城市中的日益普及可能会带来新的动态，因为自动驾驶汽车可能会偏离实时导航系统提供的最短路线，并可以使用多种算法来学习路由策略，从而可能比人类驾驶车辆（HDVs）实现更短的旅行时间，或者通过持续增加后者的旅行时间来使其处于不利地位 [ 16 , 28 ] 。

paragraphs.en: We consider a city that initially consists entirely of HDVs who learn routing strategies by updating their utility through repeated days of commuting [ 8 ] . We assume this repeated learning process brings the traffic system close to an equilibrium state [ 40 ] . Then, a subset of HDVs switches to traveling with AVs, which use Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) to learn routing policies. As learning progresses, AVs reduce their travel times and eventually achieve shorter average travel times than HDVs. However, we find that when AVs select their routes solely to minimize their individual travel times (selfish behavior), their routing policies can increase the travel times of HDVs relative to those experienced before AVs were introduced in the system (see Figure 1 A).
paragraphs.zh: 我们考虑一个最初完全由 HDV 组成的城市，它们通过日复一日的通勤不断更新自身效用，从而学习路由策略 [ 8 ] 。 我们假设这一重复的学习过程使交通系统接近于一种均衡状态 [ 40 ] 。 随后，一部分 HDV 转而与 AV 一同出行，而 AV 则使用多智能体强化学习（MARL）来学习路由策略。 随着学习过程的推进，AV 的出行时间逐渐缩短，并最终实现了比 HDV 更短的平均出行时间。 然而，我们发现，当 AV 仅以最小化自身出行时间为目标选择路线（即自私行为）时，其路由策略可能会使 HDV 的出行时间相较于 AV 引入系统之前的情况有所增加（参见图 1A）。

sents.en: We consider a city that initially consists entirely of HDVs who learn routing strategies by updating their utility through repeated days of commuting [ 8 ] .
sents.zh: 我们考虑一个最初完全由 HDV 组成的城市，它们通过日复一日的通勤不断更新自身效用，从而学习路由策略 [ 8 ] 。

sents.en: We assume this repeated learning process brings the traffic system close to an equilibrium state [ 40 ] .
sents.zh: 我们假设这一重复的学习过程使交通系统接近于一种均衡状态 [ 40 ] 。

sents.en: Then, a subset of HDVs switches to traveling with AVs, which use Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) to learn routing policies.
sents.zh: 随后，一部分 HDV 转而与 AV 一同出行，而 AV 则使用多智能体强化学习（MARL）来学习路由策略。

sents.en: As learning progresses, AVs reduce their travel times and eventually achieve shorter average travel times than HDVs.
sents.zh: 随着学习过程的推进，AV 的出行时间逐渐缩短，并最终实现了比 HDV 更短的平均出行时间。

sents.en: However, we find that when AVs select their routes solely to minimize their individual travel times (selfish behavior), their routing policies can increase the travel times of HDVs relative to those experienced before AVs were introduced in the system (see Figure 1 A).
sents.zh: 然而，我们发现，当 AV 仅以最小化自身出行时间为目标选择路线（即自私行为）时，其路由策略可能会使 HDV 的出行时间相较于 AV 引入系统之前的情况有所增加（参见图 1A）。

paragraphs.en: We therefore ask: How can AV routing MARL algorithms be designed to reduce AV travel times while limiting the additional costs on other road users, given that urban road networks are shared public infrastructure? To solve this problem, we augment the selfish travel-time AV reward with a component that accounts for each AV’s impact on the system, the marginal cost, following the formulation introduced in [ 29 ] . We show that incorporating marginal cost into AV rewards can reduce the increase in HDV travel times and allow AVs to achieve shorter travel times than under selfish AV routing (see Figure 1 B). We further find that these travel-time improvements depend on the relative weighting of the two reward components: assigning a greater weight to marginal cost can further improve HDV travel times but may increase AV and overall system travel times.
paragraphs.zh: 因此我们提出一个问题：在城市道路网络属于共享公共基础设施的前提下，如何设计自动驾驶车辆（AV）的路由多智能体强化学习（MARL）算法，才能在减少 AV 行驶时间的同时，限制对其他道路使用者产生的额外成本？ 为了解决这个问题，我们在自利的 AV 行驶时间奖励中增加了一个考量每辆 AV 对系统影响（即边际成本）的组件，其具体形式遵循 [29] 中提出的公式。 研究表明，将边际成本纳入 AV 奖励机制中，可以减少高价值驾驶车辆（HDV）行驶时间的增幅，并使 AV 的行驶时间比采用自利型 AV 路由策略时更短（参见图 1B）。 我们进一步发现，这些行驶时间的改善取决于两种奖励组件的相对权重：赋予边际成本更高的权重可以进一步缩短 HDV 的行驶时间，但可能会增加 AV 和整个系统的行驶时间。

sents.en: We therefore ask: How can AV routing MARL algorithms be designed to reduce AV travel times while limiting the additional costs on other road users, given that urban road networks are shared public infrastructure?
sents.zh: 因此我们提出一个问题：在城市道路网络属于共享公共基础设施的前提下，如何设计自动驾驶车辆（AV）的路由多智能体强化学习（MARL）算法，才能在减少 AV 行驶时间的同时，限制对其他道路使用者产生的额外成本？

sents.en: To solve this problem, we augment the selfish travel-time AV reward with a component that accounts for each AV’s impact on the system, the marginal cost, following the formulation introduced in [ 29 ] .
sents.zh: 为了解决这个问题，我们在自利的 AV 行驶时间奖励中增加了一个考量每辆 AV 对系统影响（即边际成本）的组件，其具体形式遵循 [29] 中提出的公式。

sents.en: We show that incorporating marginal cost into AV rewards can reduce the increase in HDV travel times and allow AVs to achieve shorter travel times than under selfish AV routing (see Figure 1 B).
sents.zh: 研究表明，将边际成本纳入 AV 奖励机制中，可以减少高价值驾驶车辆（HDV）行驶时间的增幅，并使 AV 的行驶时间比采用自利型 AV 路由策略时更短（参见图 1B）。

sents.en: We further find that these travel-time improvements depend on the relative weighting of the two reward components: assigning a greater weight to marginal cost can further improve HDV travel times but may increase AV and overall system travel times.
sents.zh: 我们进一步发现，这些行驶时间的改善取决于两种奖励组件的相对权重：赋予边际成本更高的权重可以进一步缩短 HDV 的行驶时间，但可能会增加 AV 和整个系统的行驶时间。

paragraphs.en: We further investigate how to make marginal cost computation scalable, since it requires an additional counterfactual simulation per AV each day of commute. In each counterfactual, we remove an AV from the traffic system and compare the remaining vehicles’ travel times with those observed when the AV is present. For example, with 400 AVs and 10,000 training iterations (equivalent to commute days), computing marginal costs for all AVs would require four million additional simulation runs. We therefore investigate whether marginal cost rewards can be computed and applied only to a fraction of the most impactful AVs on the traffic system (selective marginal cost reward shaping), rather than to all AVs (marginal cost reward shaping). We then evaluate whether selective marginal cost reward shaping can achieve system, AV, and HDV travel-time improvements comparable to those obtained with marginal cost reward shaping, relative to selfish AV routing (Figure 1 C).
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步研究了如何使边际成本计算具备可扩展性，因为每天通勤期间，每辆自动驾驶汽车（AV）都需要进行一次额外的反事实模拟。 在每次反事实模拟中，我们从交通系统中移除一辆自动驾驶汽车（AV），并将其余车辆的行驶时间与有该自动驾驶汽车（AV）存在时观测到的时间进行比较。 例如，若有 400 辆自动驾驶汽车（AV）和 10,000 次训练迭代（相当于通勤天数），则为所有自动驾驶汽车（AV）计算边际成本将需要额外进行四百万次模拟运行。 因此，我们研究了是否可以将边际成本奖励仅计算并应用于对交通系统影响最大的部分自动驾驶汽车（AV）（选择性边际成本奖励塑造），而不是应用于所有自动驾驶汽车（AV）（边际成本奖励塑造）。 接着，我们评估了选择性边际成本奖励塑造能否在相对于自私自利的自动驾驶汽车（AV）路径规划的情况下，实现与使用边际成本奖励塑造相当的系统、自动驾驶汽车（AV）和重型驾驶车辆（HDV）的行驶时间改善（图 1C）。

sents.en: We further investigate how to make marginal cost computation scalable, since it requires an additional counterfactual simulation per AV each day of commute.

paragraphs.en: We show that AV routing policies trained with MARL to minimize individual AV travel times can increase HDV travel times relative to those experienced before the introduction of AVs in the system, revealing a negative externality of selfish AV routing (see Figure 3 A, D).
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现，通过多智能体强化学习（MARL）训练、旨在最小化单个自动驾驶汽车（AV）行驶时间的AV路径规划策略，可能会增加高价值配送车辆（HDV）的行驶时间，相较于系统在引入自动驾驶汽车之前的情况而言。这揭示了自私的AV路径规划所带来的一种负外部性（参见图3 A、D）。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate that incorporating a social component, the marginal cost, into the AV reward can mitigate the increase in HDV travel times observed after AV introduction while also improving AV travel times compared to those achieved when AVs minimize their individual travel times. We further show that AV and HDV travel times depend on how much weight is assigned to the marginal cost. Higher weights can further improve HDV travel times but worsen AV and overall system performance (see Figures 3 , 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，将社会因素——边际成本——纳入自动驾驶汽车（AV）的奖励机制中，可以在自动驾驶汽车引入后缓解其导致的高密度车辆（HDV）行程时间增加的问题，同时与仅让自动驾驶汽车最小化个体行程时间的情况相比，还能缩短自动驾驶汽车的行程时间。 我们进一步表明，自动驾驶汽车和高密度车辆的行程时间取决于赋予边际成本的权重大小。 更高的权重可以进一步缩短高密度车辆的行程时间，但会恶化自动驾驶汽车以及整个系统的性能（参见图 3、4）。

sents.en: We demonstrate that incorporating a social component, the marginal cost, into the AV reward can mitigate the increase in HDV travel times observed after AV introduction while also improving AV travel times compared to those achieved when AVs minimize their individual travel times.
sents.zh: 我们证明，将社会因素——边际成本——纳入自动驾驶汽车（AV）的奖励机制中，可以在自动驾驶汽车引入后缓解其导致的高密度车辆（HDV）行程时间增加的问题，同时与仅让自动驾驶汽车最小化个体行程时间的情况相比，还能缩短自动驾驶汽车的行程时间。

sents.zh: 我们进一步表明，自动驾驶汽车和高密度车辆的行程时间取决于赋予边际成本的权重大小。

sents.en: Higher weights can further improve HDV travel times but worsen AV and overall system performance (see Figures 3 , 4 ).

paragraphs.en: Route choice can be formulated as a congestion game in which travelers repeatedly select among alternative routes in a traffic network while sharing limited road capacity [ 15 ] . Assuming homogeneous, fully rational users, this game converges to the Wardrop or User Equilibrium (UE), the Nash equilibrium in the route choice context, where no traveler can improve their travel time by unilaterally switching routes [ 39 , 6 ] . The System Optimum (SO) is the traffic allocation that minimizes total system travel time across the network [ 24 ] , but achieving it may require some travelers to take routes that are less favorable for them to improve overall system performance.
paragraphs.zh: 路线选择可以建模为一个拥堵博弈，其中旅行者在交通网络中反复从备选路线中进行选择，同时共享有限的道路容量 [ 15 ]。 假设用户是同质且完全理性的，该博弈会收敛到 Wardrop 均衡或用户均衡（UE），即路线选择情境下的纳什均衡，此时任何旅行者都无法通过单方面更换路线来缩短自己的出行时间 [ 39 , 6 ]。 系统最优（SO）是指能够最小化整个网络总系统出行时间的交通分配方案 [ 24 ]，但要实现这一目标，可能需要部分旅行者选择对他们而言不那么有利的路线，以改善整体系统性能。

paragraphs.en: Human route choice is commonly modeled using the utility-maximization decision rule [ 12 , 16 , 20 ] . The main component of the utility is the expected travel time for each route [ 7 ] , which is updated after each trip. In random utility theory, utility additionally includes a random stochastic variable that captures heterogeneity in travelers’ preferences, imperfect perception of travel time and congestion, and fluctuations in driving conditions [ 8 , 40 ] . This stochastic route choice behavior is assumed to converge to the Stochastic User Equilibrium (SUE), in which no driver believes they can improve their travel times by switching routes.
paragraphs.zh: 人类的路线选择通常使用效用最大化决策规则进行建模 [ 12 , 16 , 20 ] 。 效用的主要组成部分是每条路线的预期旅行时间 [ 7 ] ，该值在每次行程后会更新。 在随机效用理论中，效用还包含一个随机变量，用于捕捉旅客偏好的异质性、对旅行时间和拥堵状况的不完全感知，以及驾驶条件的波动 [ 8 , 40 ] 。 这种随机的路线选择行为被认为会收敛于随机用户均衡（SUE），在该均衡状态下，没有驾驶员认为通过更换路线能够缩短自己的旅行时间。

paragraphs.en: In a mixed-traffic environment where HDVs and AVs coexist, AV route assignment can be solved in several ways. MARL is a promising method [ 3 , 2 , 37 , 19 , 36 ] , where AVs can learn routing policies through repeated interactions with the traffic environment. These policies can be optimized using different objectives, such as minimizing AVs’ individual travel time, the system’s travel time, or even maximizing HDV travel times [ 3 , 16 , 2 ] . Among these objectives, if AVs optimize only their individual travel times, their routing choices may increase other road users’ travel times because of limited road capacity. This motivates the need to search for AV routing objectives that improve AV travel times while limiting the additional costs imposed on other road users.
paragraphs.zh: 在重型货运车辆（HDV）与自动驾驶车辆（AV）共存的混合交通环境中，AV 的路线分配可以通过多种方法解决。 多智能体强化学习（MARL）是一种有前景的方法 [ 3 , 2 , 37 , 19 , 36 ]，其中 AV 可以通过与交通环境的反复互动来学习路线策略。 这些策略可以通过不同的目标进行优化，例如最小化 AV 的个体行驶时间、系统的总行驶时间，甚至最大化 HDV 的行驶时间 [ 3 , 16 , 2 ]。 在这些目标中，如果 AV 仅优化自身的行驶时间，由于道路容量有限，其路线选择可能会增加其他道路使用者的行驶时间。 因此，有必要寻找既能改善 AV 行驶时间，又能限制对其他道路使用者造成额外成本的 AV 路线策略。

paragraphs.en: In economics, marginal cost denotes the change in total cost resulting from an increase in the quantity produced [ 23 ] . In transportation research, marginal cost quantifies a vehicle’s impact on the system by measuring the additional travel time it imposes on other road users through its presence in the traffic system [ 25 , 32 ] . This idea forms the basis of marginal cost pricing, in which travelers are charged according to the increase in latency their action or presence causes to the system [ 10 , 26 ] . Marginal cost pricing has also been incorporated into reinforcement learning approaches for route choice. Ramos et al. [ 30 ] , for example, incorporated marginal cost tolls into the reward signal for commuters using reinforcement learning for route choice, aiming to align individual routing decisions with system-level efficiency and minimize congestion. Inspired by the concept of marginal cost and following [ 29 ] , we define the marginal cost of an AV as the difference in travel time for all vehicles in a system when the AV is present versus a counterfactual simulation in which that AV is removed.
paragraphs.zh: 在经济学中，边际成本指的是产量增加所导致的总成本的变化 [ 23 ] 。 在交通研究中，边际成本通过衡量一辆车存在于交通系统中所给其他道路使用者带来的额外旅行时间，来量化该车辆对系统的影响 [ 25 , 32 ] 。 这一理念构成了边际成本定价的基础，即根据旅客的行为或存在给系统造成的延迟增量对其收费 [ 10 , 26 ] 。 边际成本定价也被纳入了用于路线选择的强化学习方法中。例如，Ramos 等人 [ 30 ] 将边际成本通行费纳入了使用强化学习进行路线选择的通勤者的奖励信号中，旨在使个人路线决策与系统级效率保持一致，并最小化拥堵。 受边际成本概念的启发，并遵循 [ 29 ] 的研究，我们将自动驾驶汽车（AV）的边际成本定义为：当该 AV 存在于系统中时，所有车辆的旅行时间与一个反事实模拟（即移除该 AV 的情况）之间的差异。

paragraphs.en: Prior work introduced the marginal cost reward to help MARL routing AVs reach SO solutions faster than selfish routing AVs in a toy network where the UE and SO solutions coincided [ 29 ] . In this work, we examine whether marginal cost reward shaping can prevent selfish AV routing from reducing AV travel times at the expense of HDVs in real-world traffic networks. We additionally propose a method to decrease the counterfactual simulations needed to compute the marginal cost reward by rewarding a fraction of the most impactful AVs in the system.

paragraphs.en: In the literature, researchers have studied the identification of impactful agents to explain agents’ importance in multi-agent systems. For example, Heuillet et al., [ 14 ] used Shapley values to quantify each agent’s contribution to the global reward. Chen et al. [ 9 ] stated that an agent is impactful if the system total reward is largely changing when its action is randomized. Following a similar intuition, we consider an AV to be impactful when alternative route choices lead to substantial differences in total system travel time.
paragraphs.zh: 在相关文献中，研究人员已经探讨了如何识别具有影响力的智能体，以解释这些智能体在多智能体系统中的重要性。 例如，Heuillet 等人 [14] 使用沙普利值来量化每个智能体对全局奖励的贡献。Chen 等人 [9] 指出，如果某个智能体的行为被随机化后，系统的总奖励发生显著变化，则该智能体具有影响力。 基于类似的直觉，我们认为，当替代路线的选择导致系统总旅行时间出现显著差异时，该自动驾驶车辆（AV）就具有影响力。

paragraphs.en: Research gap: To the best of our knowledge, little attention has been given to designing AV routing objectives that minimize AV travel times while mitigating travel time increases for other road users in mixed-autonomy traffic. Prior work has explored different AV routing objectives but has not explicitly investigated how to mitigate the travel time externalities these objectives may impose on HDVs or the system [ 3 , 16 , 2 ] . Similarly, existing work on difference rewards has primarily focused on cooperative settings, whereas we use the counterfactual term to account for the externalities that one agent population can impose on another while coexisting in the same environment [ 37 , 11 , 27 , 13 ] .

paragraphs.en: We study the route choice problem in which, each day, a number of vehicles make one trip from an origin to a destination point in an urban traffic network at a specific departure time by selecting a route from a set of discrete alternatives. To simulate this problem, we use the RouteRL [ 1 ] framework integrated with SUMO [ 22 ] , a continuous microscopic traffic simulator that enables modeling complex urban traffic networks and agent interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了路线选择问题：每天，若干车辆会在城市交通网络中，于特定出发时间从起点前往终点，并从一系列离散的备选路线中选择一条路线完成一次行程。 为了模拟这个问题，我们使用了 RouteRL [ 1 ] 框架，并将其与 SUMO [ 22 ] 集成；SUMO 是一款连续微观交通模拟器，能够模拟复杂的城市交通网络和智能体之间的交互。

paragraphs.en: Our urban environment initially consists only of HDVs, which choose routes using random utility theory [ 8 ] . After consecutive days of commuting, HDV route choices stabilize. Then, a number of HDVs switch to using AVs, which can use various MARL algorithms to learn routing strategies. AVs keep the departure time, origin, destination points, and action space (set of routes they can travel on) of their human predecessors. Human learning is thereafter disabled, and human route choices are sampled from the fixed learned distribution. This provides behaviorally plausible human route choices that AV routing policies can be trained on before deployment. AV observations include an estimate of each route’s travel time based on travel times of earlier-departing vehicles with the same origin and destination, together with the AV’s origin, destination, and departure time. The set of routes does not change during the simulation or from one day to the next, and both departure times and demand remain constant across simulation days.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的城市环境最初仅由 HDV 组成，它们使用随机效用理论来选择路线 [ 8 ]。 经过连续多日的通勤后，HDV 的路线选择趋于稳定。 随后，部分 HDV 转而使用 AV，后者可以利用多种 MARL 算法来学习路线策略。 AV 会沿用其人类前驱的出发时间、起点、终点以及动作空间（即它们可以行驶的路线集合）。 此后，人类的学习功能被禁用，人类的路线选择则从已固定的学习分布中采样。 这为 AV 的路线策略提供了行为上合理的人类路线选择样本，以便在部署前进行训练。 AV 的观察信息包括：基于更早出发且起点和终点相同的车辆的行驶时间对每条路线行驶时间的估计值，以及 AV 自身的起点、终点和出发时间。 在模拟过程中或从一天到另一天，路线集合不会发生变化，同时出发时间和需求在整个模拟期间也保持恒定。

paragraphs.en: To reduce the number of simulations needed to compute marginal cost counterfactuals for all AV agents in the system, we propose selective marginal cost reward shaping. In selective marginal cost reward shaping, we rank AVs by their impact on the system. We assess an AV’s impact by how much system travel times differ when it chooses different routes. Then, we compute the marginal cost m i m_{i} only for a fraction of the most impactful AVs, forming the subset ℐ MC ⊆ ℐ \mathcal{I}_{\text{MC}}\subseteq\mathcal{I} . The remaining AVs aim to minimize their own travel time. In this way, selective marginal cost reward shaping concentrates the additional counterfactual computation on the AVs with the largest estimated system impact, allowing us to investigate whether similar AV, HDV, and system travel times can be achieved with fewer counterfactual simulations.

paragraphs.en: We begin by introducing the experimental setting in Section 4.1 . Next, in Section 4.2 , we show that on two real-world traffic networks, selfish AV routing can disadvantage HDVs, whose travel times increase after AV introduction. We then demonstrate that rewarding all AVs with the marginal cost can mitigate the increase in HDV travel times and additionally improve AV travel times. Finally, in Section 4.3 , we apply the marginal cost reward only to a fraction of the most impactful AVs, and show that rewarding just 40% of AVs can achieve AV, HDV, and system travel times comparable to those obtained when marginal cost is applied to all AVs, while reducing the number of additional simulation runs by 40%.

paragraphs.en: At the beginning of each experiment, the system contains only HDVs, which repeatedly choose routes among four options over 300 days of commute, as in [ 16 , 1 , 2 ] . On day 301, a specified fraction of HDVs is replaced by AVs that learn MARL routing policies using the REINFORCE algorithm [ 41 , 18 ] , where each agent is an independent learner [ 34 ] . We use REINFORCE in our experiments, but the proposed reward formulation is not specific to this algorithm and can be incorporated into any MARL algorithm. We train the AVs for 10,000 training iterations or days of commute in both the Ingolstadt and Provins traffic networks, followed by a 100-day testing phase in which the learned policies are no longer updated. All results reported in Sections 4.2 and 4.3 are computed over the 100-day testing phase. We report the REINFORCE algorithm hyperparameters in the Supplementary Material.

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate in Figure 3 (a, d) that in both the Ingolstadt and Provins real-world traffic networks, humans consistently experience longer travel times across all examined AV penetration rates when AVs selfishly minimize their individual travel times ( β = 0 \beta=0 ). The negative relative travel-time chage indicate that after AV introduction, HDV travel times increase. AVs, on the other hand, experience shorter travel times compared to those achieved by the human drivers they replaced at episode 300 (see Figure 3 (b, e) for OPEN β = 0 ) \beta=0) . When marginal cost is incorporated into the AV reward ( β = 0.1 \beta=0.1 for Ingolstadt and Provins), the HDV relative travel time change increases relative to β = 0 \beta=0 , indicating that HDVs experience shorter travel times than under selfish AV routing. At the same time, AVs experience slightly shorter travel times on average, showing that accounting for the system does not necessarily come at the expense of AV travel times .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在图 3 (a, d) 中展示，在英戈尔施塔特和普罗旺斯这两个真实世界的交通网络中，当自动驾驶车辆（AV）自私地最小化其个体旅行时间（β = 0 \beta=0）时，在所有考察的 AV 渗透率下，人类驾驶员的旅行时间始终更长。 负值的相对旅行时间变化表明，引入 AV 后，传统驾驶员车辆（HDV）的旅行时间有所增加。 另一方面，与第 300 轮中 AV 所取代的人类驾驶员实现的旅行时间相比，AV 本身的旅行时间更短（关于 OPEN β = 0 的情况，参见图 3 (b, e)）\beta=0)。 当边际成本被纳入 AV 的奖励函数中时（对于英戈尔施塔特和普罗旺斯，β = 0.1 \beta=0.1），HDV 的相对旅行时间变化相较于 β = 0 \beta=0 有所增大，这表明 HDV 的旅行时间比在 AV 自私路径规划下的情况更短。 与此同时，AV 的平均旅行时间也略微缩短，这说明考虑系统整体效益并不必然以牺牲 AV 的旅行时间为代价。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 reports the relative travel-time change for HDVs, AVs, and all vehicles in the system, as shown in Figure 3 , when a fraction of the most impactful AVs receive the marginal cost reward. Specifically, when marginal cost is applied to the 50% and 40% most impactful AVs, HDV travel times improve by 0.5% and 0.4% compared to selfish AV routing, respectively, around 0.1% and 0.2% below the improvement obtained when marginal cost is applied to all AVs. We then tested a smaller fraction, specifically the 10% most impactful AVs, and found that HDV travel times still improve by 0.16% compared to selfish AV routing, although this is about 0.45% below the case when marginal cost is applied to all AVs. Thus, applying selective marginal cost to either 40% or 50% of the most impactful AVs could approximate the results of applying marginal cost to all AVs, retaining approximately 68% and 82% of the improvement in HDV relative travel-time change over selfish AV routing, respectively, while reducing the number of counterfactual simulations.

paragraphs.en: AVs will increasingly operate in complex, capacitated urban traffic networks, where road users compete for limited road capacity, and each user’s route choices can affect others’ travel times. AVs may use a range of algorithms, with MARL being a promising one, to learn routing strategies that may differ from, and be more efficient than, those typically made by HDVs, potentially resulting in shorter AV travel times. Understanding how MARL AV routing can influence traffic performance is crucial to understanding how this emerging technology, AVs, may shape the performance of future urban transportation systems.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we study social AV route choice in mixed-autonomy traffic environments shared with HDVs, where AVs use MARL to learn routing policies. To reduce the travel time costs AV routing imposes on other road users, we incorporate marginal cost into the AV reward. Marginal cost is a counterfactual defined as the difference in travel times for all vehicles in the system when a given AV is present versus absent from the simulation. This formulation lets us include in MARL training the trade-off between minimizing an AV’s own travel time and reducing its impact on the system.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究了与高动态车辆（HDVs）共享的混合自主性交通环境中，自动驾驶车辆（AVs）的社会化路线选择问题，其中 AVs 使用多智能体强化学习（MARL）来学习路线策略。 为了减少 AV 路线选择对其他道路使用者造成的旅行时间成本，我们将边际成本纳入了 AV 的奖励函数中。 边际成本是一种反事实概念，定义为：在模拟中，当某辆特定的 AV 存在与不存在时，系统中所有车辆旅行时间的差异。 这种建模方式使我们能够在 MARL 训练中，平衡最小化 AV 自身的旅行时间与减少其对系统整体影响之间的权衡。

paragraphs.en: Our results show that incorporating marginal cost into the AV reward can mitigate increases in HDV travel times while also reducing AV travel times relative to selfish AV routing, indicating that AVs that account for their impact on the system can improve travel times for both HDVs, AVs, and the system . However, placing greater weight on marginal cost can further improve HDV travel times at the expense of AVs and worsen total system performance. For example, at 40% AV penetration in Ingolstadt, increasing β \beta from 0 to 0.1 improves HDV, AV, and system travel time relative to the travel times before AVs were introduced by 0.6, 0.1, and 0.4 percentage points, respectively. Increasing β \beta to 0.2 yields an additional 0.1 improvement in travel time change for HDVs but reduces the relative travel time change for AVs and the system by 1.3 and 0.5 percentage points, respectively, relative to β = 0.1 \beta=0.1 .

paragraphs.en: Overall, our findings show that AV routing algorithms can influence not only AV travel times but also how travel time costs are distributed across road users. AV routing policies that optimize only individual AV travel times may systematically disadvantage human drivers. By showing that marginal cost reward shaping can reduce these effects, our results highlight the importance of designing AV routing algorithms that account for AVs’ impact on shared transportation systems.
